title: Full Starlink and Kuiper constellation populations

rights.attribution: CelesTrak standard GP; USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron via Space-Track.org.
rights.fields: Basic GP/OMM fields only. Starlink and Kuiper group membership and names are provider-supplied, including the provider DTC suffix in OBJECT_NAME. No optional status, availability or service enrichment.
rights.changes: NORAD identities normalized to decimal strings; UTC suffix and documented Earth/TEME/UTC/SGP4 defaults explicit; per-object age bounds added.

featured.selection: Densest 1-degree opening-time angular-momentum-normal neighbourhood among eligible, near-circular (eccentricity <0.003), 85–130 minute records; lowest numeric NORAD ID breaks ties.

independentAgreement.implementation: Python sgp4 2.25 / Vallado C++ plus independent GMST/ECF transform
independentAgreement.epochPrecision: Source fractional epochs retained; both propagations use JavaScript millisecond precision.
independentAgreement.limitation: Independent numerical agreement; not a measurement of element accuracy or service availability.

browserMeasurement.method: Production preview, complete population, 300x direct propagation, 120 real rAF samples after load with first 11 omitted, ten direct seeks. Main-thread sampling/UI excludes subsequent GPU draw. Worker propagation is reported separately. rAF gaps measure scheduler cadence; model-frame gaps measure changed UTC on rendered updates (the app targets about 30 Hz). Seeks wait for the requested UTC packet to commit, measured at rAF observation resolution. Engines run sequentially. No virtual clock.
browserMeasurement.limitation: Local headless desktop and phone emulation only; hardware model and physical phone not measured. Bounded local check, not a sustained physical-device frame-rate claim.

budgets.scope: Separate on-demand constellation chapter; original main edition keeps its 1,000-mover budget.
budgets.selection: No population cap or sample. Only invalid, wholly stale or unpropagatable records excluded.
budgets.orientationGuides: At most 24 illustrative orientation circles. This guide limit does not remove any satellite identities.

presentation.comparison: One constellation per load, with shared 2 November 2026 10:30–11:00 UTC bounds. Switching preserves displayed UTC and opens the full population paused. Each group is a separate capture; no simultaneous operational completeness claim.
presentation.density: One GPU point per identity. Smaller authored markers at large scale. No synthetic filling, communication links, coverage or deployment reconstruction.

validation.independent: Python sgp4 2.25 / Vallado C++ plus GMST/ECF at first, middle and last eligible time of every retained identity.
validation.physicalPhonePerformance: Unmeasured; local desktop and WebKit emulation only.

browser.scope: Full application suite in Chromium and mobile WebKit, plus existing desktop WebKit raster case. Large-population cases cover complete eligible identities, lazy group fetching, selected-record coordinate agreement, rapid seeks, in-flight pause, three-stage reveal, shared-UTC switching, both phone orientations, /zenit/ worker/assets, and worker startup recovery.
